state.description: Full state name, or `null` where the resource does not resolve it (for example practice offices).

country.description: Country name, or `null` where the resource does not resolve it (for example practice offices).

description: A postal address, shared by every public API that returns one (practice locations and offices, patient contact information, patient employment). All seven fields are always present; a field a resource cannot source is `null` rather than omitted, so one renderer works everywhere.
